'''Kirdo III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located on the [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] between [[Sevarcos II]] and [[Ma'ar Shaddam/Legends|Ma'ar Shaddam]]. It was the home world of the [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] race.

==Description==
[[File:Kintonak_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|170px|A [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]].]]
Kirdo III was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> situated on the [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] between [[Sevarcos system/Legends|Sevarcos]] and [[Ma'ar Shaddam/Legends|Ma'ar Shaddam]].<ref name="TEA" /> Its surface consisted of barren, sandy desert,<ref name="EGAS" /> oceans of red, cracked mud, and escarpments of yellow-orange hills,<ref name="GG4" /> with quicksand and caves also present.<ref name="EGAS" /> It had an arid climate<ref name="UAA" /> and winds often blew at speeds of 400-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]-per-hour<ref name="EGAS" /> or more.<ref name="UAA" /> Rainfall occurred once a decade, and when it came it lasted several days, forming lakes and filling dry riverbeds. Herds of migrating [[chooba]] grazed on [[sulfaro plant]]s and were hunted by the [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonaks]], a primitive [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="EGAS" />

==History==
Kirdo III was discovered by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] a few decades before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A number of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] traders targeted the Kitonaks.<ref name="UAA" /> The ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' stopped at the planet and, failing to find the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] it was looking for, took onboard a number of Kitonaks whom it tried (with little success) to brainwash into being [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]].<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

[[Callista Ming]] at some point in her travels stopped at Kirdo III.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', it is referred to as '''Kirdo'''.
